# BEACON — Browser-based Emergency Awareness & Coordination Open Network

> Open-source (Apache-2.0), local-first, near-real-time common operating picture (COP) for wildfires
> and floods. IEEE Response Quest 2026 — Phase 3 product (Phase-2 concept scored 4.48/5 by jury).
> Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript 5.7 strict, hexagonal ports-and-adapters, Postgres
> (Drizzle) + in-memory default, deck.gl/MapLibre map, SSE push, deterministic decision engine with
> optional LLM narration. 30 pluggable free/open data-source adapters. Runs fully offline/air-gapped
> (`docker compose up`, ~$0) and identically in cloud. Built via the GABBE agentic SDLC (S00→S13).
> This file is the entry point for AI agents: read it first, then the files in "Read-first order".

## Absolute rules (violating any of these is a critical failure)

- **NO GIT WRITES BY AGENTS — EVER.** Never `git commit`, `git push`, `git tag`, anywhere. The user
  personally runs ALL git write operations. Prepare changes in the working tree, then hand the user
  exact commands. (User directive 2026-07-17, permanent.)
- **`agents/AGENTS.md` and `agents/CONSTITUTION.md` are FROZEN.** Read and obey them; never edit.
  AGENTS.md is the operational law (symlinked to `.claude/CLAUDE.md`); CONSTITUTION.md Articles XI–XVI
  are the project-specific constitution.
- **Deterministic → AI → human (Art. XII).** Every number, ranking, distance, exposure, crest, score
  comes from deterministic code (Turf.js/SQL/typed TS). The LLM only narrates already-cited facts and
  NEVER emits a figure (enforced by `output-validator.ts` F3 contract test). App must stay fully
  functional with AI off (`AI_MODE=off` is the default).
- **HITL before public action (Art. XIII).** No CAP/EDXL alert or broadcast from an UNVERIFIED report;
  a human VERIFIER/EM approves; threshold fires create DRAFT alerts only. Telegram broadcast happens
  strictly AFTER an approved emit, via the PII-redacting notifier.
- **Link-only for third-party media.** Camera feeds / external views are hyperlinks out
  (https-only, `noopener,noreferrer`); NEVER embed, proxy, rehost, or server-fetch third-party
  video/imagery. Insecam-class unsecured-camera aggregators are permanently banned.
- **Secrets only in gitignored `.env`** (`.env*` ignored, `!.env.example` committed). Never write a
  real key into any tracked file, doc, or fixture. Placeholders only.
- **Deterministic tests.** Fixed clock (convention `2026-07-05T22:00:00Z`), no wall-clock dependence
  (inject `now`), NO live network in any test — `tests/redundancy/redundancy-acceptance.test.ts`
  `ALL_IDS` must force-MOCK every adapter id in `config/adapters.json` (a drift there = network in CI).
  Never weaken, skip, or vacuous-ify an assertion to make something pass.
- **Free/open data only; no ToS-protected scraping** (X/Twitter excluded by policy). Every source's
  license/attribution is tracked in `NOTICE` + `audit/DATA_SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md`.
- **Honest limitations.** Degradations, mock/cached modes, and approximations are stated openly in UI
  and docs — never claim LIVE for CACHED/MOCK, never delete limitation wording, never let doc counts
  drift from code (a past audit found exactly this class of defect; keep counts current).
- **Provenance is structural.** Every datum → SOURCE_RECORD; every SitRep field → citations[]; every
  API response → `{ data, provenance[], freshness }` envelope.

## Commands (exact — npx misresolves in this WSL env)

- Node: `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use` (reads `.nvmrc`, Node 24.18.0).
- Binaries: `./node_modules/.bin/{tsc,vitest,eslint,depcruise,next,playwright}`.
- Gates (all must pass before "done"): `tsc --noEmit` · `eslint . --max-warnings 0` ·
  `vitest run --coverage` · `npm run boundaries` (dependency-cruiser) · `rm -rf .next && next build` ·
  `playwright test` (needs the fresh build; visual + axe + TTTP specs included) ·
  `npm audit --audit-level=high`.
- Coverage floors (vitest.config.ts, enforced): src/domain + src/application 99/99/99/99 ·
  src/main 97/79/96/97 · src/adapters 90/83/93/90.
- Other: `npm run cli -- <cmd>` (reference CLI via tsx) · `npm run live:probe` (live source probe) ·
  `npm run dev` · `docker compose up` (infra/). `npm run docs` = the zero-dependency OpenAPI contract
  test (tests/api/openapi-contract.test.ts, also part of `vitest run`); `npm run docs:redocly` is the
  optional Redocly lint (needs `@redocly/cli` via npx, not a dependency).

## Architecture (hexagonal; boundaries enforced by dependency-cruiser)

- [src/domain/](src/domain/): pure entities/value-objects (Incident, HazardGeometry, Gauge, CameraFeed,
  PublicReport, SitRep, Alert, SourceRecord, …). No framework imports. Factories throw on invariant
  violation (e.g. `makeCameraFeed` enforces https-only viewUrl).
- [src/ports/](src/ports/): port interfaces (HazardSource, FloodGauge, Infrastructure, Outage, NewsIntel,
  CameraDirectory, Routing, LLM, Vision, Repository, MessagingPort, …).
- [src/application/](src/application/): pure use-cases — risk intersection, priority ranking, threshold
  eval, prediction (fire cone, NFHL∩crest), sitrep-synthesis + news-grounding (deterministic
  GroundedFacts minted BEFORE the LLM; misinformation flag-not-merge), pre-positioning,
  external-views (9 pure deep-link builders, clamped bbox), evac-routing.
- [src/adapters/](src/adapters/): sources/ (27 adapter dirs — see pattern below) · _shared/
  (RedundancyEngine ladder: LIVE→last-known-good cache→recorded-mock→typed-unavailable; circuit breaker;
  resilient-http with `redirect:'manual'`; anti-corruption) · persistence/ (Drizzle 19-table schema,
  drizzle/ migrations 0000–0002) · channels/ (http routes + trust pipeline, telegram webhook/poller with
  timing-safe secret + update_id replay dedupe, cli) · ai/ (compliance gateway: firewall→policy→PII
  redact→cost guardrails→hash-chained audit; LLM ladder; vision, consent-gated) · routing/ (ORS).
- [src/main/](src/main/): composition root — adapter-registry.ts (27 factories; precedence
  env `SOURCE_<PREFIX>_MODE` → region `source_mode_overrides` → manifest mode), live-composition.ts
  (PER-REGION registries; cache keys are `lkg:<adapterId>:<regionId>` so regions never cross-serve),
  live-seed.ts (fetchSlice + camera merge CA: caltrans>alertwildfire>dot511>windy; RO: cnadnr>windy),
  feature-seed, build-ai, scenario-inputs (offline seeds — Art. XVI fallback).
- [app/](app/): Next.js UI — single COP page + API routes (thin, delegate to use-cases).
  `app/_lib/types.ts` `LAYER_IDS` = 13 layers (incl. `cameras`, default OFF; external views default ON);
  exhaustive `Record<LayerId,…>` maps in map-data/build-layers/legend. `app/_components/`
  map (deck.gl builders, click-out `openExternal` https double-guard), panels (sitrep, verifier-queue
  with 2 h-TTL "Live Feed — Unofficial" chip, sos-form, logistics), ui (legend + DATA_ATTRIBUTION).
- [config/](config/): adapters.json (27 rows: id, port, mode LIVE|CACHED|MOCK, configPrefix, keyEnv) ·
  regions.json (us-ca LIVE flagship + ro CACHED; `iso`/`tz`/`languages[]` REQUIRED; ids validated against
  manifest by a drift-guard test) · locales.json (14 shipped locales, drift-guarded against
  `src/config/locales.ts` LOCALE_IDS) · planned-sources.md (roadmap-only names) · policies.yml (AI
  policy-as-code).
- [schemas/](schemas/): CAP v1.2, EDXL-RM/SitRep, adapter-manifest, policies, sustainability-v05,
  locales, regions JSON-Schemas.
- **i18n (ADR-030; wave MW-A).** `app/_lib/i18n.tsx` wraps next-intl's core `createTranslator` in a
  context whose DEFAULT is `messages/en.json`, so components render English with NO provider (every
  pre-existing test/baseline stayed valid), keys are compile-checked, and a raw key can never render.
  Locale = the **`beacon-locale` cookie**, resolved SERVER-side in the async root layout ⇒ correct
  `<html lang>`/`dir` + localized `generateMetadata` on the first byte. Fallback = server-side deep merge
  over English + `getMessageFallback`. Adding a language = one `messages/<id>.json` + one
  `config/locales.json` row + one `LOCALE_IDS` id — the allowlist is also the path-traversal guard.
  RTL is logical-CSS only (`tests/architecture/rtl-logical-css.test.ts`); the map canvas never mirrors.
  CAP goes multilingual via `capTranslationsFor()` with `capMachineValuesAgree()` proving enum tokens are
  identical across `<info>` blocks. Deterministic fact claims stay ENGLISH and language-marked (Art. XII).
- [tests/](tests/) + [e2e/](e2e/): cross-cutting suites (redundancy-acceptance, AI-parity
  numeric-equality, golden-path US+RO, perf TTTP<10s, axe, visual). Fixtures in tests/fixtures/
  (california-wildfire LIVE-labeled, romania-flood CACHED-labeled golden scenarios).

## Adapter pattern (replicate exactly; zero core change to add a source)

3 files in `src/adapters/sources/<id>/`: `<id>-acl.ts` (lenient anti-corruption: unknown fields
ignored, malformed rows dropped+counted), `<id>-adapter.ts` (class implements `SourceAdapterPort<T>` +
outward port; 3-method plug into `engine.run({mapper, fetchLive via httpGetText, loadMockRaw})`;
factory `make<X>Adapter(engine, env)` with `resolveSourceConfig({prefix, keyEnv?, requireKeyForLive?})`),
`__fixtures__/<file>` (recorded-real preferred; schema-crafted must say so in an inline `_provenance`
field or ACL header). Register: one `ADAPTER_FACTORIES` entry + one `config/adapters.json` row + add the
id to redundancy-acceptance `ALL_IDS`. Tests: clone the firms pattern (mode-switch MOCK/CACHED/LIVE,
live-down-degrades, envelope, health, factory fail-fast) + acl test.

## Verified facts (keep docs synced to these; last verified 2026-07-31 — E1 docs truth-up)

- **30 adapters registered** (adapters.json ↔ ADAPTER_FACTORIES exact, both counted directly); **28
  consumed** (23 COP data sources + 5 camera sources on the cameras layer, incl. `usgs-water` now
  consulted+cited alongside `nwps` for `us-ca`'s gauge slot — `src/main/live-seed.ts:507`
  `consultationPlan` reads a region's `enabled_adapters` directly); **2 not consumed**: `itu` +
  `camara-gsma` (operator-gated MOCK plugins by design). *(Corrects a stale 27/24/3 that undercounted the
  three MW-B B3 rows — `meteoalarm-gr`/`meteoalarm-es`/`wmo-swic` — and predated the `usgs-water` flip.)*
- **13 map layers**; cameras default OFF; per-layer freshness via layerSources.
- **306 test files / 3773 passing / 2 env-gated skips** (DATABASE_URL_TEST, OLLAMA_LIVE), run with
  `--coverage` (F-43 — never bare `vitest run`) — MW-A→MW-D complete as of 2026-07-31; re-verify before
  quoting on a still-moving tree.
- **dependency-cruiser: `npm run boundaries` (= `depcruise src`) reports 570 modules / 2065 deps, 0
  violations, 0 circulars; `depcruise src app` (the broader scope quoted elsewhere as "729 modules")
  reports 729 modules / 2598 deps, 0 violations** — both counted directly 2026-08-02. The npm script only
  cruises `src`; docs that say "729 modules" are implicitly using the wider `src app` scope, not what
  `npm run boundaries` runs — worth aligning at some point, not a truth violation today since both counts
  are real and 0-violation.
- **14 shipped locales** (`en zh-Hans hi es ar fr bn pt-BR id ur ru ro fil el`; RTL `ar`,`ur`) —
  **231 message keys** across 16 namespaces in `messages/en.json`, mirrored by every catalog.
  All 13 non-English catalogs are machine-translated and unreviewed (**including `ro`**), declared in
  `_meta` and labelled in-UI.
- **5 regions** in config/regions.json (`us-ca` LIVE flagship, `ro` CACHED, and the three DEMO-GRADE zones
  `es`/`gr`/`ph` added by B3.3 as CONFIG ONLY — no application code). `iso`/`tz`/`languages[]` are REQUIRED
  per region (schemas/regions.schema.json), and `enabled_adapters` ARRAY ORDER is that region's source
  PRECEDENCE order. The three new zones are **not at us-ca parity** and each states its own gaps in its
  `$comment`: no national gauge/camera/outage source, no ES AEMET-direct or DGT adapter, no PH floodplain
  layer, and the `es` extent covers mainland Spain + the Balearics only (not the Canaries/Ceuta/Melilla).
- **npm audit: 0 high / 0 critical; 4 moderate, dev-only** (esbuild dev-server via drizzle-kit; the only
  offered fix is a breaking drizzle-kit downgrade). `package.json overrides` pin brace-expansion ^5.0.8,
  sharp ^0.35.3, postcss → the direct devDependency (^8.5.23).
- **37 ADRs** (001–036 + 008a — 38 files on disk; one is an orphaned duplicate,
  `ADR-036-response-coordination-tier.md`, containing only a Resolution note with no original ADR body —
  the real content is in `ADR-036-warning-excellence-and-response-modules.md` §7; flagged as finding
  F-281, not fixed by this docs pass). i18n architecture = **ADR-030**, region-generic composition =
  ADR-031.
- **next-intl ^4.13.4**, used in **core-translator mode only** (`createTranslator`) — no routing, no
  middleware, no `[locale]` segment, no `NextIntlClientProvider`, next.config.mjs untouched.
- package.json `version: 0.1.0`, `license: Apache-2.0`; NO release tags exist yet (first tag comes
  after the master plan completes and the combined final audit passes).
- Repo root is the parent monorepo `/…/IEEE/Quest` (Phase2/ = submitted concept, READ-ONLY; never edit).
  `docs/audit/{JUDGE_SCORE_PREDICTION,RUBRIC_DEFENSIBILITY,PORTAL_ENTRY_VERIFICATION}.md` are
  intentionally gitignored (private strategy docs).
